deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.description:
Configuring the {integration_title} integration through YAML is deprecated, and Home Assistant could not reach your existing host `{host}` to import it automatically.

Check that `{host}` is reachable, then set up the integration through the UI (your existing host will need to be re-entered), and remove the `{domain}` entry from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.title: The {integration_title} YAML configuration could not be imported

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_credentials.description:
Configuring the {integration_title} integration through YAML is deprecated, and Home Assistant could not automatically continue using your existing host `{host}` without credentials.

Set up the integration through the UI to provide your credentials (your existing host will need to be re-entered), then remove the `{domain}` entry from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_credentials.title: The {integration_title} YAML configuration requires credentials

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown.description:
Configuring the {integration_title} integration through YAML is deprecated, and an unexpected error occurred while Home Assistant tried to import your existing host `{host}` automatically.

Set up the integration through the UI (your existing host will need to be re-entered), then remove the `{domain}` entry from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown.title: The {integration_title} YAML configuration could not be imported
